result.title: Split-KV: Efficient Context Parallelism for Training Diffusion Drafters
result.summary: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by denoising multiple draft tokens in parallel. Their training uses anchor sampling to construct compact draft queries and performs cross-attention with a block-sparse mask over a much longer context. We empirically show that acceptance length remains stable as context scales with a fixed query budget, while increasing the query budget yields diminishing quality gains, jointly establishing a practical regime with queries far shorter than the context. No existing context parallelism (CP) method jointly exploits this query--context asymmetry and meets the nonlinear, sample-dependent load-balancing requirement created by anchor sampling. We present Split-KV, an exact CP method that keeps key/value shards local and limits per-layer attention communication to query-sized tensors, making this communication independent of context length. Its global query view further enables a cost-aware longest-processing-time-first (LPT) strategy that balances context key/value chunks by their realized attention cost. At a CP size of 64, Split-KV retains 85--91\% weak-scaling efficiency and achieves up to $3.67\times$ speedup over the fastest available CP baseline. LPT achieves $<$1\% imbalance and plans three orders of magnitude faster than the best load-balancing baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/zxgx/verl.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 diffusion drafter 训练中「query 短、上下文长」的非对称性，提出 Split-KV 上下文并行方法：KV 分片本地保存，每层注意力通信只涉及 query 规模张量、与上下文长度无关，并用按实际注意力代价的 LPT 策略均衡 KV 分块。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 block-sparse 跨注意力中少量 query 读取长 KV 的通信压缩与负载划分线索，可能可供核查 LVR 里少量 latent 查询长视觉证据时的缓存与并行设计；但该工作属文本投机解码训练系统，非视觉推理研究。
